title:
I that sinned and prayed and fasted.
 
 A child Conmee saved from pandies
html_source:
The memories flow after the switch to a self defined by them and his experiences. These constitute the prime tools of Joyce’s writings – ‘he recomposed whatever he remembered, and he remembered most of what he had seen or heard other people remembering’ (Ellmann, J. James Joyce)

A pandybat -

Stephen received a beating of his hands after accidentally breaking his glasses in Portrait.

Father Conmee (below)

fondly remembered by Joyce (Ellmann) did not save Stephen from the beating but listened with apparent care to Stephen’s complaints about the injustice of his treatment from Father Dolan at Clongowes. Dolan, the martinet, was based on low-bred Father James Daly at Clongowes College (Joyce’s words to his biographer Gorman, Ellmann,R. James Joyce. Oxford Lives p28.).
Stephen’s self comprised of memories is inaccurate.

ait. Five months. Molecules all change. I am other I now. Other I got pound. 

 Buzz. Buzz. 

 But I, entelechy, form of forms, am I by memory because under everchanging forms.
anchor.suffix:
I, I and I. I. 

 A.E.I.O.U. 

 — Do you mean to fly in the face of the tradition of three centuries? John Eglinton's carping voice asked. Her ghost at least has been laid for
